series_start_reason: Nexium launched in 2001 (the Annual Report and Form 20-F 2002 says 'Nexium and Symbicort (launched 2001)'), but no AstraZeneca document on EDGAR gives a launch quarter. AstraZeneca's own 2001 and Q1/Q2 2002 results announcements are scanned paper 6-Ks, and the Q3 2002 release prints nine-month 2001 sales (295) but only Q3 2001 (168) individually, so Q1 and Q2 2001 are not separable. 2001Q3, 2001Q4, 2002Q1 and 2002Q2 are read from the prior-year columns of the Q3 2002, Q4 2002, Q1 2003 and Q2 2003 releases (direct_prior_year_column); 2002Q3 onward from each quarter's own release.
series_end_reason: AstraZeneca's Q1 2026 results release (Table 25, Product Sales year-on-year analysis, and Table 3) lists no Nexium row; Nexium is no longer broken out and falls within 'Other Medicines'. The H1 2026 release also has no Nexium row. Last printed quarter is 2025Q4 (190).
notes: Scope changes dated from AstraZeneca documents: (1) prescription medicine rights to Nexium in Europe were divested to Grunenthal, completed November 2018 (Q4 2018 release: 'In November 2018, AstraZeneca completed an agreement to divest the prescription medicine rights to Nexium in Europe'); Europe sales fell 74% in Q1 2019, so the line from 2018Q4/2019Q1 no longer carries Europe prescription sales at the earlier level. (2) Nexium OTC rights were sold in 2012 (royalty/milestone revenue sits outside Product Sales). Product Sales rows are used throughout: from 2019 AstraZeneca also prints Nexium in Total Revenue (and from 2024 Product Revenue) tables, which exceed Product Sales (e.g. Q1 2025 233 vs 228); those are not used. Rows for 2002Q3 and 2001Q3/Q4 carry AstraZeneca's original figures; the Q3 2003 release's prior-year column restates Q3 2002 as 481 (493 originally) and the Q4 2002 full year (1,978) already reflected the restatement, so 2002 quarters printed originally (347+464+493+686=1,990) do not sum to the 1,978 full year; the 2002 Q4 row therefore does not quote the full year. From 2003 the four quarters sum to the printed full year for every year 2003-2025 (2020, 2022 and 2024 within 1 for rounding). US column also exists in the regional tables from 2012Q3 (not used).

located each quarterly results release as the document that carries both a Symbicort and the product's own table row; Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 releases of 2002-11 to 2026-07 all found (release chain identical to the one already used for the Symbicort series)
